description: Land Title Settlement Department - Andiambalama, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511201
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner details, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land ownership registration and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
